symptoms: RASPA could not open an input file, usually simulation.input or another file referenced by the run.
suggested_actions: verify the job was launched from the directory containing simulation.input
check the qsub/run script cd command
regenerate simulation.input if it is missing
do not edit force-field files until the working directory is confirmed
text: LoadFile prints an input-file opening error when fopen fails for the requested path.

symptoms: ExternalTemperature parsed to zero or a negative Kelvin value. RASPA prints the diagnostic and calls exit(0), so the process return code alone can incorrectly look successful.
suggested_actions: read ExternalTemperature from simulation.input
replace it only with a positive Kelvin value explicitly provided by the user or workflow context
if no intended temperature is available, request the simulation condition instead of inventing a value
rerun RASPA and verify that a result data file is produced
text: RASPA validates ExternalTemperature after parsing and emits 'ERROR: temperature (...) should be positive' for values below 1e-10 before exiting with status zero.

patterns: number of the component is incorrect
symptoms: A Component command uses a negative or out-of-range component index. RASPA prints the input error and calls exit(0), so the process return code alone can incorrectly look successful.
suggested_actions: inspect every Component command and the requested guest list
use zero-based consecutive component indices only when the component ordering is explicit in the input or user request
for a single explicitly requested guest, use Component 0
do not change MoleculeName or MoleculeDefinition merely to repair the command index
rerun RASPA and verify that a result data file is produced
text: RASPA validates Component indices during input parsing and rejects negative, out-of-range, or duplicate component numbers.

symptoms: RASPA did not find pseudo_atoms.def in the local or selected force-field directory; atom typing and charges may be incomplete.
suggested_actions: ensure Forcefield points to an installed force-field directory
copy or generate pseudo_atoms.def into the run/force-field location
check that atom names in the CIF and molecule definitions exist in pseudo_atoms.def
text: RASPA reports pseudo_atoms.def missing when the local and force-field fallback lookup both fail.

symptoms: RASPA looked up a pseudo-atom name that is absent from the loaded pseudo-atom table; the unresolved name is printed after the final colon.
suggested_actions: read the unresolved pseudo-atom name from the error line
check that the selected Forcefield supplies a readable pseudo_atoms.def containing that exact name
compare CIF and molecule-definition atom names for spelling and case mismatches
select only an installed compatible force field supported by file-backed evidence; do not invent pseudo-atom parameters
text: ReturnPseudoAtomNumber exits after its case-insensitive search fails to find the requested name in the loaded PseudoAtoms array.

symptoms: RASPA did not load generic Lennard-Jones mixing-rule parameters; VDW interactions may be undefined later.
suggested_actions: ensure the selected Forcefield directory contains force_field_mixing_rules.def
copy a validated force_field_mixing_rules.def for the chosen force field
if a pair is intentionally excluded, define it explicitly as none rather than leaving it undefined
text: RASPA warns that force_field_mixing_rules.def was not found and was not used.

symptoms: RASPA did not load specific pair interactions or overrides from force_field.def.
suggested_actions: ensure the selected Forcefield directory contains force_field.def when specific interactions are required
copy a validated force_field.def for the selected force field
check missing VDW-pair warnings after restoring this file
text: RASPA warns that force_field.def was not found and was not used.

symptoms: RASPA could not open a molecule definition or related file path.
suggested_actions: check MoleculeName and MoleculeDefinition values in simulation.input
verify the referenced molecule .def file exists
copy the molecule definition into the RASPA molecule directory or local run path
check filename case sensitivity
text: Molecule file readers print Cannot open with strerror when a requested definition file is unavailable.

symptoms: A molecule definition contains an unsupported group type.
suggested_actions: open the molecule .def file
replace the group type with Flexible or Rigid as appropriate
regenerate the molecule definition from a validated template if uncertain
text: RASPA expects molecule groups to be Flexible or Rigid.

symptoms: simulation.input requests a framework structure format that RASPA does not recognize.
suggested_actions: check StructureFormat in simulation.input
use a RASPA-supported format such as CIF when using framework CIF files
ensure FrameworkName matches the actual structure file stem
text: RASPA reports Unknown structure-format when the requested framework format is not supported.

symptoms: RASPA could not open FrameworkName.cif in the run directory or in the installed share/raspa/structures/cif repository.
suggested_actions: verify FrameworkName matches the intended CIF filename stem
check whether FrameworkName.cif exists in the run directory or installed CIF repository
restore or refetch the identified framework from a trusted structure source
request a corrected user CIF when the intended structure cannot be recovered
text: ReadFrameworkDefinitionCIF first tries the current directory and then the installed structures/cif repository; if both fopen calls fail it reports that the resolved CIF path does not exist.

symptoms: A framework atom referenced by a modification or forbidden-connectivity rule is absent from the loaded framework atom types.
suggested_actions: compare the atom labels/types in the CIF with the rule in simulation.input
fix the atom name in the modification or connectivity rule
remove the rule if it was copied from another framework
text: RASPA validates framework atom names used by modification and connectivity rules.

patterns: ERROR in cif-file: cell length A not recognized
symptoms: The CIF lacks parseable _cell_length_a/_cell_length_b/_cell_length_c values.
suggested_actions: repair or regenerate the CIF header
ensure cell lengths are finite numeric values
convert the structure through ASE or another CIF normalizer
avoid editing atom coordinates unless the CIF is globally corrupt
text: RASPA emits cell length errors when CIF cell-length fields cannot be parsed.

patterns: ERROR in cif-file: cell angle alpha not recognized
symptoms: The CIF lacks parseable _cell_angle_alpha/_cell_angle_beta/_cell_angle_gamma values.
suggested_actions: repair or regenerate the CIF header
ensure cell angles are finite numeric values in degrees
convert the structure through ASE or another CIF normalizer
text: RASPA emits cell angle errors when CIF cell-angle fields cannot be parsed.

patterns: ERROR in cif-file: no proper space group definition found
symptoms: RASPA could not determine the framework space group from CIF symmetry information.
suggested_actions: normalize the CIF to P1 if symmetry metadata is unreliable
add or repair _symmetry_space_group_name_H-M, Hall symbol, or symmetry operations
try ForceSpaceGroupDetection only when atom positions are consistent
text: RASPA requires usable CIF symmetry information or a robust P1 representation.

symptoms: A CIF or framework definition supplies an invalid space-group identifier.
suggested_actions: check the CIF space-group number/name fields
convert the CIF to P1 to remove ambiguous symmetry
regenerate the framework CIF from a trusted source
text: RASPA prints Wrong space group number when the supplied identifier is outside the supported space-group set.

patterns: WARNING: INAPPROPRIATE NUMBER OF UNIT CELLS USED
symptoms: The replicated simulation box is too small relative to twice the VDW cutoff in at least one direction.
suggested_actions: increase UnitCells/NumberOfUnitCells in simulation.input
or lower CutOffVDW only if scientifically justified
ensure each replicated cell length is larger than 2*CutOffVDW
text: RASPA checks whether 2*CutOffVDW exceeds the replicated box length.

patterns: WARNING: THE SYSTEM HAS A NET CHARGE
symptoms: The sum of framework, adsorbate, and cation charges is nonzero.
suggested_actions: check framework atom charges from CIF/pseudo_atoms.def
check molecule .def charges
disable or revisit charge equilibration only if it was unintended
do not simply zero charges unless that matches the force-field model
text: RASPA sums all framework, adsorbate, and cation charges and warns when the net charge is nonzero.

patterns: WARNING: THERE ARE ATOM-PAIRS WITH NO VDW INTERACTION
symptoms: At least one active pseudo-atom pair has no defined VDW potential.
suggested_actions: add the missing pair to force_field_mixing_rules.def or force_field.def
check pseudo atom names for typos/case mismatch
if the interaction is intentionally absent, define it explicitly as none
validate that the selected Forcefield matches the framework and guest
text: RASPA records missing interactions when a used pseudo-atom pair has UNDEFINED_POTENTIAL with VDW enabled.

symptoms: A class of VDW interactions has been intentionally or accidentally disabled.
suggested_actions: check simulation.input interaction toggles and force-field settings
restore the omitted interaction class unless the calculation intentionally excludes it
document intentional omissions because adsorption results can change strongly
text: RASPA can warn when whole classes of VDW interactions are omitted.

patterns: WARNING: REINSERTION MOVE USED ON CHARGED IONS
symptoms: A reinsertion move is enabled for charged ions, which RASPA warns may cause numerical problems.
suggested_actions: replace reinsertion move probability for charged ions with random translation when possible
lower or disable reinsertion-related probabilities for ionic components
check molecule component charge definitions
text: RASPA warns when reinsertion moves are used for components with nonzero net charge.

patterns: WARNING: GRID ENERGY INTERPOLATION PROBABLY NOT ACCURATE ENOUGH
WARNING: GRID FORCE INTERPOLATION PROBABLY NOT ACCURATE ENOUGH
symptoms: Grid interpolation error is likely too large for energy or force calculations.
suggested_actions: increase grid resolution or regenerate the grid
avoid grid acceleration for sensitive validation runs
compare against direct energy evaluation for a short run
text: RASPA has separate warnings for inaccurate energy and force grid interpolation.

symptoms: RASPA detected energy inconsistency; results should not be trusted.
suggested_actions: treat the run as failed even if it reaches DONE
check for bad force-field parameters such as tiny sigma or missing repulsion
check initial structure/guest overlap and molecule definitions
rerun with safer moves or shorter diagnostic settings
text: RASPA explicitly states that energy drift makes simulation results wrong.

patterns: Fatal error: Can not use starting bead
symptoms: CBMC growth starts from a hydrogen bead while using the MM3-hydrogen potential, which RASPA forbids.
suggested_actions: edit the molecule definition so the starting bead is a heavy atom such as carbon
regenerate the molecule .def with a valid starting bead
do not change simulation conditions until the molecule topology is fixed
text: RASPA exits when the MM3-hydrogen potential is used with an invalid starting bead.

patterns: WARNING: THE LOWENSTEIN RULE IS NOT OBEYED
symptoms: A framework violates the Lowenstein rule according to RASPA's framework checks.
suggested_actions: verify whether the framework chemistry really permits the violation
check atom typing and framework composition
do not auto-fix unless the framework source is known to be wrong
text: RASPA adds a Lowenstein-rule warning during framework warning creation.
